s00-01-pivot-ca7c26.wav.text: Most people think they know this one.

s00-02-story-8172c3.wav.text: Don't use God's name as a swear word. And that's part of it.

s00-03-grave-3a9342.wav.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain,

s00-04-grave-bd2019.wav.text: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.

s00-05-talk-0d0b04.wav.text: But the words underneath reach far beyond your mouth.

s00-06-pivot-701d64.wav.text: You can break this commandment without saying a word.

s01-01-story-ae1a58.wav.text: To see why, go back to a desert, and a bush that burned but did not burn up.

s01-02-story-c31442.wav.text: Moses was sent back to Egypt to set God's people free.

s01-03-talk-580273.wav.text: And Moses asked a simple question.

s01-06-grave-30efc5.wav.text: This is my name forever, and thus I am to be remembered throughout all generations.

s02-01-talk-8feffc.wav.text: In Hebrew, that name is four letters, often written Yahweh.

s02-02-talk-8601f2.wav.text: When your Bible prints LORD in capital letters, that's this name.

s02-03-story-b6d13d.wav.text: In the Bible, a name isn't just a label.

s02-04-story-f373ea.wav.text: It tells you who someone is.

s02-05-talk-2d9e9e.wav.text: And God handed his name to a crowd of slaves, so they could call on him.

s03-01-pivot-b49e0b.wav.text: So when God speaks from the mountain, he guards that name.

s03-03-story-9d6fdf.wav.text: The Hebrew word for take means to lift up, or to carry.

s03-04-talk-894f90.wav.text: And in vain means empty, or hollow.

s03-05-story-3cf674.wav.text: Like a promise with nothing inside.

s03-06-story-71bc5a.wav.text: In other words, don't carry his name around emptily.

s04-02-story-d8b012.wav.text: Using his name as a curse, or as a shrug.

s04-04-story-5eecf6.wav.text: In Israel, people swore by God's name to show they meant it.

s04-05-grave-c78a6c.wav.text: You shall not swear by my name falsely, and so profane the name of your God: I am the LORD.

s04-06-talk-7a41f9.wav.text: Lying with God's name attached dragged him into the lie.

s05-01-pivot-72e996.wav.text: But here's where it gets bigger.

s05-02-story-c19242.wav.text: Israel didn't only speak God's name. They wore it.

s05-03-story-f6650f.wav.text: After the priests' blessing, God said:

s05-04-grave-a9ef8f.wav.text: So shall they put my name upon the people of Israel, and I will bless them.

s05-05-talk-d4366a.wav.text: Think of a bride on her wedding day.

s05-06-story-57ac94.wav.text: She takes her husband's name, and everywhere she goes, she carries it.

s05-07-talk-44d44e.wav.text: Many readers hear the third commandment that way.

s05-08-story-77cf73.wav.text: Israel was carrying God's name into the world.

s06-01-story-db7460.wav.text: How they lived would tell the nations what their God was like.

s06-02-grave-8c809c.wav.text: So you can carry the name emptily without ever saying it.

s06-03-talk-1ffae5.wav.text: Calling yourself his, while living as though he isn't there.

s06-05-story-9ab031.wav.text: But the people carrying it can make it look small.

s07-01-story-1d5151.wav.text: Centuries later, Jesus taught his followers to pray.

s07-02-story-3888c5.wav.text: And the first thing he asked for was this.

s07-03-grave-daa91a.wav.text: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.

s07-04-talk-460146.wav.text: Hallowed means treated as holy, set apart.

s07-06-talk-920631.wav.text: Christians have long read that line as the third commandment turned into a prayer.

s07-07-grave-28ce02.wav.text: Don't carry his name as if it weighs nothing.

s07-08-story-bd550c.wav.text: Carry it like the best thing you own.

s07-09-story-9d5d9a.wav.text: Next time, the fourth commandment, and a day God made for rest.
